description: Generate a structured postmortem report for a completed SRT incident. Includes timeline, root cause, what worked/failed, prevention actions, real timing metrics (TTD/TTDiag/TTR), an ESTIMATED ROI (humanTimeSaved/costAvoided from a severity-bucket heuristic — not measured savings, flagged via roiEstimated/roiBasis), and optional playbook delta. Classification: ADVISORY.

incident_id.description: Incident ID to generate postmortem for

name: srt_generate_postmortem
